title.narrative: Building Holistic Journalistic Capacity to Document and Address TFGBV

description.narrative: Technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV) is an emerging threat to freedom of expression, journalist safety and gender equality in Bangladesh’s digital public sphere. Women journalists and women in public life are increasingly exposed to online harassment, cyberstalking, image-based abuse, coordinated digital attacks and AI-enabled deepfakes, yet awareness and institutional response mechanisms remain limited. This project aims to strengthen the capacities of journalists, editors and media institutions to identify, document and responsibly report TFGBV through survivor-centered, trauma-informed and rights-based approaches. It is expected that, based on the project outcomes, stronger newsroom standards, ethical reporting practices and institutional response mechanisms will be promoted, while relevant stakeholders will be encouraged to integrate TFGBV-sensitive reporting guidance and digital safety protocols into media training, editorial policies and professional development programmes across Bangladesh.
